correctness.rationale: From the primary full-text lattice P1/P2/P3, exact independent exhaustive rational computations give 22 points, eight facets, ten vertices, eight unimodular maximal cones and two quadrilateral four-ray cones with all triple determinants unit. Their dual semigroups are explicit conifold hypersurfaces. Every toric small resolution requires one of two unimodular diagonals per cone, bounding the count by four. Four explicit rational support perturbations yield projective smooth normal fans refining the source fan with no new rays, proving existence and distinctness. Standard small Gorenstein resolutions are crepant with exceptional (-1,-1)-curves; toric Picard and cohomology yield the stated Betti numbers. Both proof and standard-library exact checker were reconstructed and successfully run.

originality.rationale: The initiating 2026 Example 5.3 supplies the three constituent polytopes and establishes nonsmoothness, but does not enumerate small models or simultaneous projective support perturbations. Can--Saha (2023) and general Richardson singular-locus criteria can constrain the singular set, but they do not classify the four projective toric Q-factorializations. Standard affine conifold theory gives two local rulings without settling their four simultaneous global projective realizations. Full-text and indexed-statement comparisons found no source implying this specific global conclusion.
residual_risks: An older differently indexed explicit computation might identify the same fan and its four coherent chambers; absence from searches is not a uniqueness proof.
The result is restricted to toric equivariant projective small resolutions over the fixed target; abstract or non-equivariant classifications are not addressed.
The initiating preprint lists primary arXiv category math.AG but no author-designated five-character MSC; 14M25 classifies this mathematical theorem by its toric geometry.

value.rationale: The object is a naturally highlighted toric Richardson threefold; local node small resolutions need not admit arbitrary simultaneous projective global realization. The explicit four coherent models and square flop network therefore determine a nontrivial natural birational invariant of the example. The result additionally gives all exceptional loci and cohomology of the resulting smooth projective toric models, without arbitrarily restricting parameters. Residual concern is differently indexed older fan-specific work.
